description: Appointment to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. W.A. Dharmasiri, who is currently serving as the District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Galle, is due to retire from the public service after 2026-01-25. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint Mr. K.U. Chandralal,  Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as the Secretary to the Southern Provincial Ministry of Sports & Youth Affairs, Rural Development, Cultural & Arts Affairs, Social Welfare, Probation & Child Care Services, Women's Affairs & Home Economic Promotion, Housing & Construction, and Manpower and Security, to the vacant post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Galle, with effect from 2026-01-26.
